entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers lowering to around 800 metres Wednesday morning and afternoon and up to 1cm of snow may accumulate on the road at times.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Showers are expected to fall as snow above 800 metres from Tuesday night to Wednesday morning. 1 to 2 cm may accumulate on the road about the summit, with lesser amounts lower down.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers are expected to affect the Road above 800 metres from Tuesday night to early Wednesday morning. 1 to 2 cm may accumulate on the road about the summit, with lesser amounts lower down.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited
